prompt_text: Who was the captain of the second mission that flew to the moon
raw_response:
The second crewed mission that actually flew to the Moon was **Apollo 10**.  
Its commander (the “captain” of the flight) was **Thomas P. Stafford**.  

- **Apollo 8** (first crewed lunar‑orbit mission) – Commander Frank Borman.  
- **Apollo 10** (second crewed lunar‑orbit mission, a “dress‑rehearsal” for Apollo 11) – Commander Thomas P. Stafford, Pilot John W. Young, Lunar Module Pilot Eugene Cernan.
